description: Get a picture address to use as an image shape's src: upload one you have (file_path to a local image, or base64 + mime_type) — free — or generate one from a prompt (charged in coins like the editor's Generate image). Returns the URL; then create the image with sketchxflow_canvas_apply.

file_path.description: A local image file (png, jpg, webp, gif, svg, avif), max ~6 MB.

name: sketchxflow_canvas_image
title: Add a picture for a canvas page
